items.name: Mandarin orange / tangerine, whole, unpeeled
items.preparation: raw, whole, peel on; grams are for the edible pulp only (whole fruit with peel is about 150 g)

scale_cues: Square white dinner plate about 22-25 cm across, in an overhead view. The fruit's diameter is about 1/3 of the plate's width, so roughly 7-8.5 cm.
assumptions: The fruit is one mandarin or tangerine. It could be a small navel or Valencia orange: the surface texture and slightly flattened shape suggest a mandarin.
The peel (about 20-25% of the fruit's weight) is not counted as edible mass.
The reddish-orange smears on the plate are leftovers from an earlier dish and are not counted as food.
There are no sauces, oils or drinks.
